sources.claim: Counterfactual regret minimization (CFR) minimizes counterfactual regret in imperfect-information extensive-form games and was demonstrated on large poker abstractions.

DeepStack combines recursive reasoning/re-solving and learned value estimation for heads-up no-limit Holdem, illustrating that practical no-limit systems rely on decomposition and approximation rather than brute-force full-tree solving.
Depth-limited solving for imperfect-information games requires special handling of continuation strategies/values; ordinary perfect-information leaf evaluation is insufficient.
Python Decimal supports exact decimal representation and controllable precision/rounding, useful for avoiding binary-float artifacts in authoritative monetary arithmetic.

findings.finding: A practical no-limit solver should be layered: correctness on small games first, then abstractions/re-solving/imported strategy data with explicit approximation metadata.
findings.decision_impact: Create solver spike + Kuhn/Leduc CFR ladder before Holdem tree work.

findings.finding: Decision quality depends on trustworthy state/range/value inputs; no solver can compensate for corrupted hand parsing or opportunity statistics.
findings.decision_impact: Core state, math, data provenance, and test corpus precede advanced strategy work.

findings.finding: Exact decimal/integer chip handling is preferable to binary float for authoritative pot and amount accounting.
findings.decision_impact: Adopt integer/Decimal precision contract and limit float to numerical simulation outputs with tolerances.

assumptions.statement: The first solver objective is a practical study assistant, not an exact solution of unrestricted multiway no-limit Holdem.
assumptions.validation: Benchmark solver approaches and document the approximation envelope in ADR-SOLVER-001.

contrary_evidence.statement: Imported commercial/precomputed strategies may provide stronger immediate baselines than a new local solver.
contrary_evidence.impact: Keep strategy schema source-agnostic and prioritize import provenance alongside solver R&D.
